member.name: T:ExtraBridgeLoader.ExtraBridgeUtils
member.summary: The class containing methods for controlling the operation of Extra Bridge Loader.

member.name: M:ExtraBridgeLoader.ExtraBridgeUtils.AddOnCompleteBridgesAction(System.Action)
member.summary: Adds an action to be called when bridge processing is complete. (that is, when all bridge-integrated entities have their custom data loaded and their int ids prepared for access by original code).
member.param: The action to be performed once all bridges report completion.

member.name: F:ExtraBridgeLoader.ExtraBridgeUtils.customGiftGenerators
member.summary: A checked for creation of special Extra Bridge gift appearances not fitting within the simple sprite model (e.g. auras). The first generator argument is the gift's resource name (after the "ExtraBridge_" prefix), the second is the parent transform, and the output should be the created custom gift appearance (NOT uninstantiated prefab!).

member.name: P:ExtraBridgeLoader.ExtraBridgeUtils.ShowGiftPassives
member.summary: Controls whether gift passives handled by Extra Bridge Loader should be properly displayed in the passive list UI in combat. The default value is . If Basemod for Workshop is detected, this is set to automatically.
